description: Kent County Council is an upper-tier authority (county council). Default is procurement_paid. Pension fund transfers bucket to internal_transfer. REDACTED / accrual rules added if the raw CSV feed exposes them — not all counties do.

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions — direct payments to individuals (foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct payments, CYP direct payments, Staying Put arrangements). Lawfully unnamed. Pattern covers REDACTED, REDACT, [REDACTED], and REDACTED-suffix variants (e.g. 'REDACTED PERSONAL DATA', 'REDACTED - PERSONAL PAYMENT', 'REDACTED - SPECIFIC VENDOR').
Kent CC Pension Fund is the council's own pensions vehicle — money from the general fund to the pension fund is an internal transfer, not third-party procurement.

match.supplier_regex: ^(COMMERCIAL SERVICES KENT LTD|KENT SOCIAL CARE PROFESSIONALS LTD)$

rules.reason: KCC wholly-owned trading subsidiaries. Commercial Services Kent Ltd (CSK/Commercial Services Group, wholly-owned since 2010, est. trading company vehicle) £101M / 40K txns. Kent Social Care Professionals Ltd is KCC's in-house social-work temp agency. Council-to-own-subsidiary flows, not third-party procurement.
